name: canopy
description: Git graph for Claude Code: a nudge above the prompt when your branch has unpushed commits, and a pane with every branch and worktree of the repo.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the prompt nudge and the graph pane.

refreshSeconds.title: Auto refresh (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the graph re-reads git in the background; 0 turns the timer off (it still refreshes after each turn and after git commands).

commits.title: Commits in the graph
commits.description: How many recent commits the graph draws at first; the pane's More button adds this many again.

graphTheme.title: Graph theme
graphTheme.description: auto follows the app's light or dark appearance.

push.title: Push from the pane
push.description: Off keeps canopy read-only. On adds a push button for each branch with unpushed commits; nothing is pushed until you confirm.

worktreePush.title: Pushing worktree branches
worktreePush.description: allow: like any branch. perRepo: only in repositories whose local git config names a remote under the key below, and only to that remote. block: never from the pane.

worktreePushKey.title: Git config key for perRepo
worktreePushKey.description: Repository-local git config key that names the remote worktree branches may be pushed to, e.g. git config --local canopy.worktreePushRemote origin. Point it at your own key if you already keep one.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated. Pushing one takes a second confirmation; the remote's default branch is always included.

respectHooks.title: Respect pre-push hooks
respectHooks.description: Git hooks do not run when canopy pushes. On: a repository with a pre-push hook is not pushed from the pane (use a terminal). Off: push anyway, skipping the hook.
